title: Universal Model Router offline policy evaluation

dataset.source_note: All candidates and evaluation labels are synthetic policy fixtures derived from checked-in profiles. They are not real model performance evidence.

labeling_rules.qualified: A case is qualified only when it has at least one candidate pre-labelled acceptable; any selected candidate in that set is a hit, and abstention is a miss.
labeling_rules.must_abstain: A case must abstain when its task/policy fixture has no admissible candidate. Any selected candidate is a wrong route.
labeling_rules.multiple_acceptable_candidates: Positive cases intentionally accept multiple synthetic candidates; labels do not encode a real quality ordering among them.
labeling_rules.splits: Forty hand-authored development cases cover the policy matrix. Ten holdout cases use altered input variants and reserved negative-case variants; both splits remain small synthetic fixtures.

metric_definitions.top1_hit_rate_on_qualified: Qualified cases selecting any profile in acceptable_profile_ids divided by all qualified cases; abstention is a miss.
metric_definitions.wrong_route_rate_all_cases: Qualified cases that abstain or select outside acceptable_profile_ids plus must_abstain cases that select any profile, divided by all cases.
metric_definitions.abstain_precision: Correct abstentions on must_abstain cases divided by all predicted abstentions; N/A when no strategy output abstains.
metric_definitions.abstain_recall: Correct abstentions on must_abstain cases divided by all must_abstain cases; N/A when there are no must-abstain cases.
metric_definitions.coverage_on_qualified: Qualified cases with any selected profile divided by all qualified cases.

methods.popularity_ungated: Select highest fixture downloads; ignores eligibility and execution status.
methods.text_relevance_ungated: Select maximum token overlap between query and candidate metadata; ignores eligibility and execution status.
methods.popularity_shared_eligibility: Same hard eligibility decision as the router, then select highest downloads from eligible candidates.
methods.text_relevance_shared_eligibility: Same hard eligibility decision as the router, then select maximum token overlap from eligible candidates.
methods.evidence_router: Current router with registered adapters and out-of-band approved fixture evaluation digests.
methods.comparison_note: The ungated rows measure eligibility-gate value. The shared-eligibility rows isolate ranking. These synthetic cases cannot establish live model quality.
